_readme: Daily Ideas board seed for board.html and en/board.html. Overwrite this file to refresh the day. Each idea needs rank, id, idea_id, title_zh, title_en, command, signal (High or Med-High), channels (IG and/or TikTok), tiktok_priority, status (proposed|approved|in_chat|qa|claude|done), why_zh, why_en, vocab[{w, j, en}]. Copy engagement from the signals report. Leave unknown fields out. Do not invent views, likes, or Jyutping.
jyutping_note_zh: 粤拼按 overnight signals 原文照录（报告写明来自记忆）。请抽查 濕濕碎 seoi3、暗戀 am3 lyun2。煩死在词表里没有粤拼，这里留空，没有补写。
jyutping_note_en: Jyutping is copied from the overnight signals report, which says it is from memory. Spot-check 濕濕碎 seoi3 and 暗戀 am3 lyun2. 煩死 has no Jyutping in the vocab line, so it is left blank.
